name: Foster Care Associates (FCA)
basis: per child per week; page says the allowance has two parts (expenses for the child and a professional fee) but does not label the weekly figures as the combined total
depends_on: child's age and complexity of needs; placement type (standard child over 11 = £508.20; enhanced/complex = £549; parent and child up to £917)
quote: Our allowances range from £460 – £917 depending on the age of the child and the complexities.
notes: pageDate is the HTML metadata modified date, not visible text. Also states 'Our standard rate for a child over the age of 11 years is £508.20 per week, per child.' Worked examples: 4-year-old £474.18; 7-year-old £484.19; 15-year-old £508.20; 12-year-old additional needs £549.15; mother and baby up to £917.16. £250 summer and winter bonuses are on top.

name: FCA Scotland
basis: per child per week, described as 'allowances'; page does not state whether the fee is included
depends_on: child's age and complexity of needs; placement type
quote: Our weekly allowances range from £460 – £711 depending on the age of the child and the complexities.
notes: pageDate is the HTML metadata modified date. Also: 'Our standard rate for a child over the age of 11 years is £489 per week, per child.' Headline 'up to £2,179 per month' per child.

name: National Fostering Group (NFG)
basis: average per child per week; page says fostering pay 'is made up of 2 parts' (an allowance for the child's needs and a professional fee) and the FAQ says the figure 'covers their professional fee and their foster child's needs'
depends_on: type of fostering (standard average £487; enhanced/complex needs average £652), skills, location, number of children
quote: An average of £487* per child per week.
notes: UK-wide group (England, Scotland, Wales); figures are group averages. Visible text: 'Content last updated: November 2025' (no day given). Examples: standard 15-year-old £496.23; enhanced 11-year-old £658.07; two sisters aged 6 and 7 £1,000.02; parent and baby £1,020.11. Page says all pay information is 'a guide only'.

name: Fosterplus
basis: per week; page says the weekly payment 'is split into two parts' (child allowance and professional fee) but does not label the range as the combined total
depends_on: where you live (England or Scotland), your experience, the child in your care
quote: between £408 and £502 per week, depending on where you live, your experience and the child in your care.
notes: pageDate is the HTML metadata modified date. Operates in England and Scotland. Examples: one 5-year-old in England £463.68/wk; two siblings aged 9 and 14 in England £998.76/wk; 12-year-old with complex needs in Scotland £649.04/wk; parent and baby £753.48/wk. Annual range stated as £21,479–£27,199 per child (a second section says £20,421–£26,161).

name: Compass Fostering
basis: per child per week; page says 'Your fostering payment is made up of' a professional fee and a living allowance for the child; figures described as 'illustrative only'
depends_on: number of children, child's needs, type of fostering (standard £434–£465.50 by age; therapeutic £668.50; parent and child £791), carer experience
quote: With Compass, our foster parents typically receive between £430 and £800 per child, per week.
notes: Visible: 'Figures shown: 2026/27 tax year · Last checked: 23 September 2026' and 'Last updated: 23 September 2026'.

name: Capstone Foster Care
basis: 'Total allowances' per week per arrangement; page does not split fee and allowance
depends_on: child's needs (level of training/support required), child's age, location, type of arrangement (standard over £460; therapeutic MATTS up to £660; parent and child from £910), number of children
quote: Total allowances for most of our standard arrangements, including respite payments, are over £460 per week.
notes: No visible date for pay figures; tax section references 2026 to 2027 tax year. FAQ gives a slightly different standard figure ('upwards of £450 per week'). Parent and child 'starts from £910 per week' (headline 'up to £47,320 per fostering arrangement, per year').

name: Fostering People
basis: per child per week; meta description says carers receive 'a fostering allowance and fee for each child' but body does not split or label the figures as totals
depends_on: child's age (standard for child over 5 in England over £521), individual needs (enhanced allowance), type of placement (mother and baby example £849.06), number of children
quote: In England our standard rate for a child over the age of 5 years is over £521 per week, per child
notes: pageDate is the HTML metadata modified date. Also: 'Our allowances range from £493 – £900.' and 'our minimum weekly allowance is £493, most receive a minimum of £521 per week or more.' Examples: one 8-year-old £521.01; two children aged 10 and 13 £1,042.02; 6-year-old with additional needs £765.58. Meta description says 'over £443 per week' (inconsistent with body).

name: Five Rivers Child Care
basis: 'a weekly foster care allowance made up of a professional fee and a living allowance for the child'; stated as 'up to', not split
depends_on: child's age, whether siblings are also placed, additional needs (payments adjusted)
quote: Standard allowance for one child up to £470
notes: pageDate is the HTML metadata modified date. Also: 'Parent and child – £924.49 per week'. Meta description: 'in the region of £21,800 per year'. Birthday and festival allowances £200 each.

name: ISP Fostering
basis: per child per week; 'the weekly fostering payment' described as two parts (cost of the child plus professional fee); tier figures are the full weekly payment
depends_on: carer tier: Core £572.74, Main £635.46, Senior £660.52 (London: £616.70 / £685.51 / £713.16); parent and child £946.75
quote: You'll receive £572.74 per week, per child.
notes: pageDate is the HTML metadata modified date. Page summary: 'We pay between £572 – £713 per week.' Annual: 'up to £33,134 fostering allowance per year for each child' (£35,744 in London).

name: TACT Fostering
basis: average weekly pay per placement; Fostering Pay described as a maintenance payment plus a fee, and birthday, festival, holiday, short-break and council-tax elements 'have been prorated into the weekly pay examples'
depends_on: child's age, complexity of needs (single child average £491; child with additional needs £564), number of children (two children £982), type of care (parent and child £817)
quote: Receive an average* of £491 per week
notes: pageDate is the HTML metadata modified date. TACT operates in England, Wales and Scotland. Page warns actual figures 'could be greater or lower than the figures shown'. Paid fortnightly, only while a child is in placement.

name: Orange Grove Foster Care
basis: per child per week; allowance described as comprising a child's allowance and a foster parent payment, figures not split or labelled as totals
depends_on: carer grade (Grade 1 £410–£497; Grade 2 £420–£507; Grade 3 £430–£517, based on experience/training/years fostering) and child's age
quote: At Grade 1, you'll receive between £410 and £497 per week, per child, depending on their age.
notes: pageDate is the HTML metadata modified date. Examples: 7-year-old £465; 14-year-old £497; two children aged 8 and 10 £931; parent and newborn £755. A comparison line still cites a '23/24' range of £371–£478, so parts of the page may be older. Headline 'up to £27,162 per year per child'.

name: Nexus Fostering
basis: single worked example (therapeutic carers) stated per week, tax free; page does not say whether it is allowance plus fee
depends_on: age and needs of the child, type of fostering (therapeutic pays more), carer experience; paid per child
quote: They foster a 7 year old with additional needs and receive £780.29 per week, tax free.
notes: No weekly 'from' figure. Other examples are annual only: 'Stephanie fosters an 11 year old girl and receives £27,168.64 per year, tax free'; parent and child carer 'receives £52,554 per year'. Footer '© Nexus Fostering 2023-2026'.

name: Barnardo's Fostering
basis: fees and allowances combined: 'the payment you receive from us will be made up of two elements' (per-child allowance and foster carer fee); £495 is an average, £630 an upper figure
depends_on: type of foster care, number of children, child's age, child's needs
quote: On average you'll receive £495 per week
notes: Visible text: 'Last updated: September 2024' (no day). Also: 'fees and allowances can go up to £630'. UK-wide charity; no fees or allowances paid when no child is in placement.

name: Swiis Foster Care (England)
basis: 'a combined allowance each week' (part for the child's costs, part a fee for the carer); all weekly figures stated as 'up to' per placement type
depends_on: placement type and number of children (one child up to £625; enhanced one child placed alone with additional needs up to £1,380; two siblings up to £1,218; two unrelated children up to £1,250; parent and child up to £1,167), child's age, region, individual assessment
quote: Swiis foster carer's pay for one child in arrangement is the equivalent to £32,500.
notes: pageDate is the HTML metadata modified date. Page says 'Fostering Allowances are correct at the time of publishing and are subject to change.' £500 annual bonus and £150 per child for birthdays/Christmas are extra.

name: Swiis Foster Care Scotland
basis: 'a combined allowance each week' (child's costs plus carer fee); 'Swiis pays up to' table by age band: 0–4 £442; 5–10 £471; 11–15 £559; 16+ £563
depends_on: child's age, placement type (one child up to £563; enhanced one child up to £746; two siblings up to £986; two unrelated children up to £1,126; parent and child up to £746), additional needs, region
quote: These figures are effective from the 1st April 2026.
notes: Date is visible on the page (comparison table 'effective from the 1st April 2026'). Page: 'the above fees are an indication of the weekly payments made for each placement type'.

name: Surrey County Council
basis: per child per week; Payment Level 2 and 3 totals = allowance plus skills fee (£113.46 at Level 2, £226.92 at Level 3); Level 1 is allowance only
depends_on: carer payment level (1–3, by skills and training; 'most carers will begin at Payment Level 2') and child's age band (0–4, 5–10, 11–13, 14–17)
quote: these payments can total up to £570 per child, per week
notes: Visible 'reviewed 17 Jun 2026'. Level 1 (allowance only): £218.08 / £247.35 / £329.76 / £383.12. Level 2: £331.54 / £360.81 / £443.22 / £496.58. Level 3: £445 / £474.27 / £556.68 / £610.04. Headline 'up to £570' conflicts with the Level 3 14–17 table figure of £610.04. Parent and child total stated as £1,154.83 (intro says up to £1,102.57).

name: Wigan Council
basis: weekly rate per child by carer tier and DfE age band; booklet does not explicitly state that tier rates combine allowance and skills fee (Tier 1 'maintenance payment' only = £176–£267, matching the national minimum; higher tiers exceed it)
depends_on: carer tier (Tier 2 newly approved £296.23–£418.29; Tier 3 experienced £373.69–£518.71; Tier 4 specialist £725.18 / £812.49 / £915.01) and child's age band (0–2, 3–4, 5–10, 11–15, 16–17)
quote: Fostering Allowances and Fees for Foster Carers with effect from 06/04/2026
notes: Date visible in the booklet title. Only three Tier 4 figures are given and the fetch could not confirm which age bands they align to. The HTML page (https://www.wigan.gov.uk/Resident/Health-Social-Care/Children-and-young-people/Fostering/Foster-carer-support-package-update.aspx) shows older, undated figures: newly approved £257.45–£363.19; experienced £324.12–£449.60; specialist £702.83–£790.63; plus an additional needs allowance of £14.91–£149.15.

name: Kent County Council (Kent Fostering)
basis: weekly total per child = maintenance (allowance) plus reward (fee), by age band and fostering type
depends_on: child's age band (under 2, 2–4, 5–8, 9–10, 11–15, 16–18) and type of fostering: standard £341.82–£574.30; solo and complex £486.56–£849.22; disabled children standard £424.30–£656.78; disabled enhanced £451.79–£684.27; parent and child up to £1,191.04
quote: Depending on the type of foster care, you could get up to £1,191.04 per week (based on one parent and child arrangement).
notes: No date or year stated on the page. Connected person carers receive maintenance only unless they complete training. Solo and complex amounts are reviewed every 3 months.

name: City of Edinburgh Council (Edinburgh Fostering)
basis: weekly payments per child; page lists a weekly fee (£307.50 for ages 0–11 and 12+; £490.06 disability and specialist) and a weekly standard allowance by age (£177.70 / £206.72 / £206.72 / £283.37); the stated range equals fee plus allowance but is not explicitly labelled as such
depends_on: child's age and placement type (disability and specialist fee is higher)
quote: Our carers receive weekly payments from £485.20 to £696.78 for fostering one child under 16
notes: No year in body text; downloads on the page are labelled 'Foster Carer Rates 2025' and 'Carer Payments 2026'; HTML metadata dates 25 March 2022. Continuing care 18–21: fee £307.50 plus £283.37 living costs. Holiday and birthday allowances extra.

name: Renfrewshire Council
basis: per child per week, stated as made up of a weekly fostering payment (fee) of £330.46 per child plus a weekly allowance by age (£178.56 age 0–4; £207.73 age 5–15; £284.75 age 16–17)
depends_on: child's age (allowance); the £330.46 fee is a flat per-child amount
quote: You could get up to £615.21 per week, per child.
notes: Visible publication date 17 April 2026. Page only states the top combined total (£615.21 = £330.46 + £284.75); lower-band totals are not stated. Annual: 'up to £31,990.92 a year for each child'. Continuing care 18–21: £206 allowance plus £330.46 fee.

name: East Sussex County Council
basis: table column 'Weekly payments total' under the heading 'Combined Fostering Maintenance Allowance and Professional Fee'
quote: Combined Fostering Maintenance Allowance and Professional Fee
notes: No date or year on the page. Table is an image; ranges per band reflect the professional fee which 'reflects the needs of the young person'. Staying Put 18+ allowance £238.50.

name: Foster Wales Swansea (Swansea Council)
basis: per week per child; page does not say whether allowance and fee are combined
depends_on: type of fostering, number of children, length of fostering
quote: you can receive between £442 and £1,087 per week, per child
notes: pageDate is the HTML metadata modified date. No tiers, age bands or fee/allowance split on the page.

name: London Borough of Bromley
basis: per child per week total = child allowance plus carer professional fee, shown in a table with a Total column
depends_on: child's age band (0–4 £407.66; 5–10 £431.66; 11–12 £463.66; 13–15 £515.27; 16+ £557.27); enhanced fee of £50 per week by agreement; parent and child total £823.93
quote: This includes the maintenance fee for the child or young person and the professional fee for you.
notes: pageDate is the HTML metadata modified date. Allowance £208–£309 by age; fee £206.66 (under 13) or £258.27 (13+). Paid fortnightly. Christmas, birthday and summer holiday allowances extra.

name: Sheffield City Council
basis: total weekly payment per child = fostering allowance (follows the national minimum, by age) plus skill level fee, shown as a totals table
depends_on: carer skill level (Level 1 £301–£443; Level 2 £366–£458; Level 3 £386–£468) and child's age band (0–4, 5–7, 8–10, 11–15, 16+)
quote: It is paid per child per week and increases as you progress through training and gain more experience.
notes: No date or year on the page. Allowance £176 / £194 / £220 / £258 by age; skill fee £125–£210. Weekly disability allowance £40–£60 extra; £35/wk extra for 16+. Examples: Level 2 one 6-year-old £384/wk; Level 3 three children £1,337/wk.

name: Birmingham Children's Trust (Foster Birmingham)
basis: fee per child per week (Level 3 £217.28; Level 4 £294.58) plus child maintenance allowance £184.75–£292.45 per child per week by age; only the worked examples give a 'Total Weekly Payment' (£402.03 for Level 3 with one child aged 4)
depends_on: carer level (3 or 4), child's age, number of children
quote: A Level 3 foster carer looking after one child aged 4 would receive:
notes: Visible published date 3 July 2026; disclaimer says figures 'were correct at the time of publication'. Second example: Level 4 with two children aged 2 and 8 = £977.57 total. No top-of-range total stated. The Trust's procedures page (birminghamcs.trixonline.co.uk) could not be fetched (robots disallowed).

name: Foster for Greater Manchester (10 GM councils incl. Manchester)
basis: combined weekly fee and allowance per child
depends_on: carer experience, type of fostering, child's age; each GM council sets its own rates
quote: the combined weekly fee and allowance can range from anywhere between £268 and £560 per child.
notes: Regional recruitment hub for all ten Greater Manchester councils; no per-council breakdown. Additional allowances 'in excess of £2,000 per year, per child'.

name: HSC Northern Ireland Foster Care (all five HSC Trusts)
basis: fostering allowance only (per child per week: 0–4 £149; 5–10 £166; 11–15 £187; 16+ £219), paid every 28 days; no fee stated on this page
depends_on: child's age; 'Additional funding may be available depending on the needs of the child / young person'
quote: Every 28 days, a fostering allowance is paid for each child or young person in your care.
notes: No date on page. Regional HSC NI site covering Belfast, Northern, South Eastern, Southern and Western Trusts. Separate Northern Trust fee-paid scheme page (http://www.adoptionandfostering.hscni.net/fostering/fee-paid-scheme-northern-trust) states 'fees of £13,000 and £18,000 per annum' in addition to allowances, with no weekly total.

name: Leeds City Council (Foster4Leeds)
basis: components only: weekly allowance per child by age (0–4 £186.74; 5–10 £207.27; 11–15 £251.58; 16+ £306.06) plus Payment for Skills weekly fee per child by level (Level 1 none; Level 2 £146.93; Level 3 £207.38; Level 4 £268.38); no combined weekly total stated
depends_on: child's age (allowance) and carer PFS level (fee)
quote: Financial support: Weekly allowance plus weekly fee of £146.93 per child.
notes: No year stated. Annual examples described as 'roughly': Level 2 with two children aged 8 and 12 about £41,200/yr; Level 3 with one 14-year-old about £25,200/yr.

name: Foster Wales Cardiff (Cardiff Council)
basis: components only: child's allowance £208–£260 per week by age plus 'a fee of £200' paid 'on top of allowances' (fee frequency not stated); no combined total stated
depends_on: child's age (allowance); number of children and type of fostering
quote: In Cardiff, the child's allowance payment is £208-260 per week, depending on the child's age.
notes: pageDate is the HTML metadata modified date. One-off £5,000 support package for newly approved carers of children over 3.

name: Hartlepool Borough Council
basis: components only: weekly allowance by age (0–4 £176.35; 5–10 £200.88; 11–15 £250.06; 16+ £304.21, labelled 2024) plus weekly fee by skill band (Band 2 £93.29; Band 3 £185.34; Band 4 £277.41; Specialist £423.48); no combined total stated
depends_on: child's age (allowance) and carer skill band (fee)
quote: a weekly fee determined by our payment for skills model and based on your fostering skill level
notes: Allowance rates labelled '2024'; fee figures undated.

name: Stirling Council
basis: components only: weekly allowance by age (0–4 £168.31; 5–10 £195.81; 11–15 £195.81; 16+ £268.41) plus fostering fee £177.64 per week; no combined total stated
depends_on: child's age (allowance); fee is flat
quote: Carers will receive a fostering fee of £177.64 per week.
notes: Page references the Scottish Recommended Allowance agreed August 2023; no rate year stated. Post-placement retainers paid as multiples of the weekly fee.

name: Somerset Council (Fostering in Somerset)
basis: worked example only: total for two children (allowances plus fees); standard rate tables are images and could not be read; Fostering Plus fee stated as '£235 fee per child'
depends_on: child's age (allowance), scheme (Fostering Plus £235 fee; Step Forward £614.25 fee; complex medical needs / single placement £433.29 fee; parent and child fee £514.13)
quote: He receives £478.19 per week in allowances, and £235.40 per week in fees, making a total of £713.59 per week.
notes: No rate year stated; linked info booklet dated 11-11-2022, so figures may be older. Parent and child example total £1,009.85/wk. 'High Need foster carers receive around £45,000 per year in fees and allowances.'

name: Foster Wales Newport (Newport City Council)
basis: single example only (two children); page does not say whether it is allowance plus fee
depends_on: type of fostering, number of children, length of placement
quote: right now in Newport there are foster carers who receive £660 per week for fostering 2 children aged 4 and 8 years old.
notes: pageDate is the HTML metadata modified date. No standard rates on the page.

name: Foster Wales (national, all 22 Welsh councils)
basis: national minimum allowance per child per week only (table labelled 'Weekly 2026/2027 allowances': 0–2 £229; 3–4 £229; 5–10 £208; 11–15 £208; 16–17 £260); fee payment described but not quantified for Wales
depends_on: child's age band and number of children (allowance); fee depends on carer's skills, training and experience and varies by council
quote: This is usually around £229 a week for under 4's up to £260 a week for over 16's (in Wales).
notes: Allowance table labelled 2026/27 (sourced to The Fostering Network); tax section marked 'update: 09/03/2026'; HTML metadata modified 20 July 2026. Illustrative examples on the page (£200 + £100 fee for a baby; £366 + £177 fee for two children) are not labelled as Welsh rates.
